styleDirection: User-selected simple flat anime cels, close to existing Soyo
prompts: Draw a NEW Japanese TV-anime / visual-novel sprite atlas in the SIMPLE FLAT ANIMATION-CEL STYLE of the GIRL in image1. Look at her clean fine outlines, simple flat facial planes, natural 2D eyes, restrained two-tone coloring and uncomplicated hair shapes. Ignore ALL background, interface and text in image1. Image2 supplies ONLY the new character's recognizable design: a young orange-haired girl with golden-brown eyes, sunflower hair clip and black ribbon, long orange hair, white-and-brown flower-themed dress with gold edging. Preserve that design and youthful identity but newly DRAW it with natural 2D anatomy. Do not trace any 3D face topology, doll rigidity, rendered materials or illumination from image2. Strictly flat animation cels: thin clean dark-brown lines, opaque flat local color, at most ONE crisp flat shadow color per material, large simplified hair locks; simple drawn nose and mouth. No gradients, no airbrush, no shiny plastic, no glossy hair streaks, no modeled volume, no ambient occlusion, no realistic cloth texture, no painterly illustration. Simplify embroidered flowers into clear flat graphic motifs. Match image1's 2D school-anime aesthetic even though this girl's costume is different. ONE transparent 3-column, 3-row sprite atlas, nine separated head-to-waist/upper-thigh cutouts with complete hands, same front-facing camera and head size, consistent head placement. VERY LARGE transparent gutters: every figure occupies only central 65% width and 80% height of its cell; nothing crosses into another cell. Nine states in row-major order: neutral calm relaxed arms; happy clear smile and soft open hand; sad downcast brows/mouth and hands gently held; angry furrowed brows/firm mouth and hand on hip; surprised wide eyes/small open mouth/hand near chest; shy blush/averted eyes/fingers lightly held; thinking thoughtful eyes/one hand at chin; serious steady eyes/straight mouth/natural stance; relieved relaxed smiling eyes/soft smile/hand lightly on chest. Natural plausible fingers and relaxed shoulders, no rigid T/A poses. Expressions change eyebrows/eyes/mouth as well as small hand gesture. Not chibi, no super-deformed doll, no 3D-to-2D filter. Genuine alpha transparent background, no painted light or shadow halo, no labels/grid/background/UI. Portrait 4:5 overall canvas.

Keep this exact simple 2D animation-cel drawing style, nine character faces, costume colors, gestures and row-major expression order. Make only a sprite-layout correction: uniformly shrink ALL nine figures by about 20%, keep each centered within its own 3-by-3 cell, and create BROAD EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTERS between columns and rows and around the outer edges. Each figure should occupy at most 70% of its cell width and 80% of its cell height. Include the complete hair and all hands, with the lower cut at waist/upper skirt. All nine use the same scale and camera. No cutout may touch a neighbor. Do NOT add detail, soft shading, shine, volume or new lighting; retain clean thin lines, flat colors and a single hard shadow per material, simplify tiny floral detail if necessary. Preserve young orange-haired girl with sunflower hair ornament and white/brown dress, all nine different expressions/hand gestures unchanged. The result is one transparent atlas with isolated 2D anime cutouts and no background, border, label, cast shadow or glow.
layoutNote: Fixed same-size view rectangles select the isolated original cutouts, aligning head positions without altering pixels.
